question: Who is Chris Griffin?
answers: middle child of the Griffin family
reply: Chris Griffin is the middle child of the Griffin family. Seth Green has voiced him since his first appearance in "Death Has a Shadow" (January 31, 1999). He's 13 when the show starts and says he's 16 by "Adult Education."
source: Christopher Cross "Chris" Griffin is the middle child of the Griffin family. He is 13 when the series begins and reports he is 16 by the time of "Adult Education". Full name: Christopher Cross Griffin. Voiced by: Seth MacFarlane in the "Pilot Pitch", Seth Green starting in "Death Has a Shadow", Kevin Michael Richardson while under the influence of mushrooms in "You May Now Kiss the...Uh...Guy Who Receives". Age: 16. Occupation: Paperboy from "To Love and Die in Dixie" until "Movin' Out (Brian's Song)", resumes in "Boys & Squirrels", Cashier at Quahog Mini-Mart from "Movin' Out (Brian's Song)" to "Boys & Squirrels". Chris Griffin first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: Who is Jason Voorhees?
reply: Jason Voorhees is the slasher villain from the Friday the 13th horror films. Ari Lehman first played him in the 1980 original, and Family Guy first used him in "It Takes a Village Idiot, and I Married One," which aired on May 13, 2007.
source: Jason Voorhees is a fictional character from the Friday the 13th series of slasher films. He first appeared in the 1980 film Friday the 13th, in which he was portrayed by Ari Lehman. The character has subsequently been represented in various other media, including novels, comic books, and a crossover film with another iconic horror film character, Freddy Krueger. Jason Voorhees first appeared in the episode "It Takes a Village Idiot, and I Married One", which first aired on May 13, 2007.

question: What is Peanuts?
answers: comic strip by Charles M. Schulz
reply: I'd call Peanuts a comic strip written and drawn by Charles M. Schulz. It ran daily and on Sundays from 1950 to 2000 and follows Charlie Brown, a boy with bad luck, and his dog Snoopy. Its first appearance on Family Guy was in the episode "Mother Tucker."
source: Peanuts is a syndicated daily and Sunday comic strip written and illustrated by Charles M. Schulz, which ran from October 2, 1950, to February 13, 2000; the day after Schulz's death, continuing in reruns afterward. The strip is considered to be one of the most influential in the history of the medium, with 17,897 strips published in all. It chronicles the adventures of unlucky boy named Charlie Brown, and his dog, Snoopy. Peanuts first appeared in the episode "Mother Tucker", which first aired on September 17, 2006.

question: Who is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart?

source: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (27 January 1756 – 5 December 1791) was a prolific and influential composer of the Classical era. He composed over 600 works, many acknowledged as pinnacles of symphonic, concertante, chamber, operatic, and choral music. Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart first appeared in the episode "Peter Problems", which first aired on January 5, 2014.

question: Who is Nate Griffin?
reply: Nate Griffin is Peter Griffin's great-great-great-great grandfather. He was an African slave who worked as the Pewterschmidt family's stable boy, and he first appeared in "Peter Griffin: Husband, Father...Brother?", which aired on December 6, 2001.
source: Nathaniel "Nate" Griffin is Peter Griffin's Great-Great-Great-Great Grandfather and was an African slave. Nate Griffin was supposedly born in Quahogswana, Africa, and his real name was Richard Bachman, instead like many slaves, being allowed to choose his own American name. He belonged to the Pewterschmidt family and was their stable boy. While working as a slave for the "massa", Nate peed in their cereal each day and had sex with Lois's great ancestor as well as her fine sister. He currently resides in Heaven where there is a shortage of chairs. Nate Griffin first appeared in the episode "Peter Griffin: Husband, Father...Brother?", which first aired on December 6, 2001.

question: What is Ferris Bueller's Day Off?
reply: Ferris Bueller's Day Off is a 1986 comedy film written and directed by John Hughes. It stars Matthew Broderick, and Family Guy first referenced it in "Yug Ylimaf," which aired on November 11, 2012.
source: Ferris Bueller's Day Off is a 1986 comedy film written and directed by John Hughes. It stars Matthew Broderick, Alan Ruck, Mia Sara, Jeffrey Jones and Jennifer Grey. The film was released by Paramount Pictures on June 11, 1986. Ferris Bueller's Day Off first appeared in the episode "Yug Ylimaf", which first aired on November 11, 2012.

question: Who is John Herbert?
reply: John Herbert is the elderly pedophile who lives at 35 Spooner Street with his old, crippled dog Jesse. He's a retired U.S. Army veteran, voiced by Mike Henry, and he became obsessed with Chris when Chris took a paper route in "To Love and Die in Dixie."
source: John Herbert is an elderly pedohebephilewho lives at 35 Spooner Street with his old, crippled dog, Jesse. He has a high-pitched, very soft, effeminate voice and with a slight whistle lisp. He is often seen wearing a light blue robe and slippers and uses a zimmer-frame walker to get around. He is a retired United States Army veteran. He becomes fixated on Chris in "To Love and Die in Dixie" when Chris took up a paper route and developed an unhealthy obsession with him. When the family returned from the South, he left 113 messages asking what had happened to the paper boy. Full name: John Herbert. Voiced by: Mike Henry. Occupation: Retired U.S. Army Veteran, Elder Member of Skull and Bones Society. John Herbert first appeared in the episode "To Love and Die in Dixie", which first aired on November 15, 2001.

question: What is The A-Team?
reply: The A-Team is an American action-adventure TV series about ex-US Army Special Forces soldiers who were branded war criminals for a crime they didn't commit. They work as soldiers of fortune while on the run from the military. Frank Lupo and Stephen J. Cannell created it, and it ran on NBC from 1983 to 1986. It first came up on Family Guy in "We Love You, Conrad."
source: The A-Team is an American action adventure television series about a fictional group of ex-United States Army Special Forces who work as soldiers of fortune while being on the run from the military after being branded as war criminals for a "crime they didn't commit". The A-Team was created by writers and producers Frank Lupo and Stephen J. Cannell at the behest of Brandon Tartikoff, NBC's Entertainment president. The show ran for five seasons on the NBC television network from January 23, 1983 to December 30, 1986. The A-Team first appeared in the episode "We Love You, Conrad", which first aired on May 3, 2009.

question: Who is Diane Simmons?
answers: Tom Tucker's co-anchor on Quahog 5 News
reply: Diane Simmons was Tom Tucker's co-anchor on Quahog 5 News. She also hosted a talk show called Diane!, and she eventually became a murderer. Lori Alan voices her, and her first appearance was in "Death Has a Shadow."
source: Diane Simmons (née Seidelman) was Tom Tucker's co-anchor on Quahog 5 News and eventually became a murderer. Although when the series started, she and Tom seemed to have a healthy and at times possibly sexual relationship, that quickly changed to where they instead bicker a lot on the air, and she soon became the butt of his jokes. This relationship started spiraling around the time of her 40th birthday. She also hosted a talk show called Diane!, on which the Griffins were guests and exposed their secrets. The show was first seen in "Fifteen Minutes of Shame". Full name: Diane Simmons. Voiced by: Lori Alan. Age: 40 (Deceased). Occupation: Quahog 6 News co-anchor with Mike Tucker in Pilot Pitch, Quahog 5 News Co-Anchor with Tom Tucker from "Death Has a Shadow" until prior to "And Then There Were Fewer", Host of the talk show Diane!. Diane Simmons first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: Who is Seamus Levine?

source: Seamus Levine (pronounced "SHAY'-muss") is a tough fisherman with wood for arms and legs. He is also blind in one eye, and so wears a black eye-patch. He is a blatant parody of fictional salty sea-dogs and pirates. Full name: Seamus Levine. Voiced by: Seth MacFarlane. Occupation: Fisherman, Talk-show host, Organist. Seamus Levine first appeared in the episode "Model Misbehavior", which first aired on July 24, 2005.

question: Who is John & Patricia Ramsey?
reply: John and Patricia Ramsey were the parents of JonBenét Ramsey. She was a child beauty pageant star who was found murdered in the family's home in Boulder, Colorado in 1996, and the case is still unsolved. The couple first appeared on Family Guy in "Brian Wallows and Peter's Swallows," which aired January 17, 2002.
source: John & Patricia Ramsey were the parents of JonBenét Patricia Ramsey (August 6, 1990 – December 25, 1996), an American child beauty pageant star who was discovered murdered in her home in Boulder, Colorado in 1996. The six-year-old's body was found in the basement of the family home nearly eight hours after she was reported missing. She had been struck on the head and strangled. The case, which after several grand jury hearings remains unsolved, continues to generate public and media interest. John & Patricia Ramsey first appeared in the episode "Brian Wallows and Peter's Swallows", which first aired on January 17, 2002.

question: What is SpongeBob SquarePants?
reply: SpongeBob SquarePants is an American animated TV series that follows its title character and his friends in the underwater city of Bikini Bottom. It's one of Nickelodeon's highest-rated shows, and it first showed up on Family Guy in "Road to Rupert," which aired on January 28, 2007.
source: SpongeBob SquarePants is an American animated television series. Much of the series is centered around the exploits and adventures of the title character and his various friends in the underwater city "Bikini Bottom". The series' popularity has prompted the release of a media franchise, contributing to its position as Nickelodeon's highest rated show, the most distributed property of MTV Networks, and among Nickelodeon's most-watched shows. SpongeBob SquarePants first appeared in the episode "Road to Rupert", which first aired on January 28, 2007.

source: Kate is Brian's blind girlfriend in "The Blind Side" until he discovers she hates dogs. Kate first appeared in the episode "The Blind Side", which first aired on January 15, 2012.

question: Who is Consuela?
answers: Hispanic character from a cutaway gag
reply: Consuela started out in a cutaway gag and became a regular Hispanic character on the show. She's one of the few cutaway characters to do that. She speaks very broken English and calls everyone "Mister," whatever their gender. She first appeared in "Believe It or Not, Joe's Walking on Air," which aired on October 7, 2007.
source: Consuela is of Hispanic origin and speaks very broken English. For example, she uses incorrect sentence structure. She refers to everyone as "Mister" someone or other, regardless of their gender. According to Stewie, this may be because she does not know the meaning of the word, "mister". She is noteworthy for being one of the few characters to originate in a cutaway gag that became a "regular" character on the show, interacting with the other "normal" characters. Consuela first appeared in the episode "Believe It or Not, Joe's Walking on Air", which first aired on October 7, 2007.

question: Who is Justin Bieber?
reply: Justin Bieber is a Canadian pop/R&B singer, songwriter and actor, best known for his debut single "One Time" and his platinum-certified debut album My World. On Family Guy, he first showed up in the episode "Quagmire and Meg," which aired on January 8, 2012.
source: Justin Drew Bieber (born March 1, 1994) is a Canadian pop/R&B singer, songwriter and actor. Bieber's debut single, "One Time", was released in 2009 and peaked in the top ten in Canada and charted in the top thirty in several international markets. His debut album, My World, followed in November 2009, and was later certified platinum in the United States. He became the first artist to have seven songs from a debut album chart on the Billboard Hot 100. Justin Bieber first appeared in the episode "Quagmire and Meg", which first aired on January 8, 2012.

question: Who is Kool-Aid Man?

source: The Kool-Aid Man is the mascot for Kool-Aid, a brand of flavored drink mix. Kool-Aid Man first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: What is Scooby-Doo?
reply: Scooby-Doo is an animated Saturday morning series. It started in 1969 with the Hanna-Barbera show Scooby-Doo, Where Are You! and is about a talking dog named Scooby Doo and his teenage friends. On Family Guy, it first appeared in "I Never Met the Dead Man," which aired on April 11, 1999.
source: Scooby-Doo is an animated series produced for Saturday morning television in several different versions from 1969 to the present. The original series, Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!, was created for Hanna-Barbera Productions and has produced numerous spin-offs and related works until being absorbed in 2001 into Warner Bros. Animation. They have handled production since then. All versions of the show feature a talking dog named Scooby Doo; the original series included four teenagers or young adults: Fred "Freddie" Jones, Daphne Blake, Velma Dinkley, and Norville "Shaggy" Rogers. question: Who is Abraham Lincoln?
answers: led the country through the Civil War
reply: Abraham Lincoln was the 16th President of the United States. He served from March 1861 until he was assassinated in April 1865, and he led the country through the American Civil War. On Family Guy he first showed up in "Peter, Peter, Caviar Eater," which first aired on September 23, 1999.
source: Abraham Lincoln (February 12, 1809 – April 15, 1865) served as the 16th President of the United States from March 1861 until his assassination in April 1865. Abraham Lincoln first appeared in the episode "Peter, Peter, Caviar Eater", which first aired on September 23, 1999.

question: Who is Harrison Ford?
reply: Harrison Ford is an American film actor and producer, best known as Han Solo in the original Star Wars trilogy and as Indiana Jones. His first Family Guy appearance was in "Stewie Kills Lois," which first aired on November 4, 2007.
source: Harrison Ford (born July 13, 1942) is an American film actor and producer. Ford is best known for his performances as Han Solo in the original Star Wars trilogy and as the title character in the Indiana Jones film series. He is also known for his roles as Rick Deckard in Blade Runner, as John Book in Witness and as Jack Ryan in Patriot Games, and Clear and Present Danger. His four-decade career also includes roles in several other Hollywood blockbusters, including Apocalypse Now, Presumed Innocent, The Fugitive, Air Force One, and What Lies Beneath. Harrison Ford first appeared in the episode "Stewie Kills Lois", which first aired on November 4, 2007.

question: Who is Mary Poppins?
reply: Mary Poppins is a magical English nanny from P. L. Travers' children's books. The East wind blows her to Number Seventeen Cherry Tree Lane in London to look after the Banks children. On Family Guy she first showed up in "Lethal Weapons," which aired on August 22, 2001.
source: Mary Poppins is a series of children's books written by P. L. Travers and originally illustrated by Mary Shepard. The books centre on a mysterious, vain and acerbic magical English nanny, Mary Poppins. She is blown by the East wind to Number Seventeen Cherry Tree Lane, London  and into the Banks' household to care for their children. Encounters with chimney sweeps, shopkeepers and various adventures follow until Mary Poppins abruptly leaves, i.e., "pops-out". The adventures take place over a total of eight books. However, only the first three books feature Mary Poppins arriving and leaving. Mary Poppins first appeared in the episode "Lethal Weapons", which first aired on August 22, 2001.

question: Who is Jay Leno?

source: James Douglas Muir "Jay" Leno (born April 28, 1950) is an American stand-up comedian and television host. From 1992 to 2009 and again starting March 1, 2010 he is the host of NBC's The Tonight Show with Jay Leno. In between his two stints, he was the host of his own self-titled show entitled The Jay Leno Show. Jay Leno first appeared in the episode "Patriot Games", which first aired on January 29, 2006.

question: Who is Bertram?

He first appeared in "Emission Impossible," which aired on November 8, 2001, and later showed up in "Sibling Rivalry" and "The Big Bang Theory."
source: Bertram was the son of a gym teacher and her partner through artificial insemination. Bertram's biological father, through a sperm bank mishap fixing, is Peter Griffin. Bertram has appeared in "Emission Impossible", "Sibling Rivalry" and in "The Big Bang Theory". Bertram first appeared in the episode "Emission Impossible", which first aired on November 8, 2001.

question: What is Cheers?
reply: Cheers is an American sitcom that ran on NBC for eleven seasons, from 1982 to 1993. It's set in the Cheers bar in Boston, where a group of locals meet to drink and chat, and on Family Guy it first came up in "The Boys in the Band," which aired on September 25, 2016.
source: Cheers is an American situation comedy television series that ran for eleven seasons from 1982 to 1993. It was produced by Charles/Burrows/Charles Productions in association with Paramount Network Television for NBC, having been created by the team of James Burrows, Glen Charles, and Les Charles. The show is set in the Cheers bar, named for the toast "Cheers", in Boston, Massachusetts, where a group of locals meet to drink, relax, chat and have fun. Cheers first appeared in the episode "The Boys in the Band", which first aired on September 25, 2016.

question: Who is Seth MacFarlane?

source: Seth Woodbury MacFarlane (born October 26, 1973) is an American animator, writer, producer, actor, singer, voice actor, and director best known for creating the animated sitcoms Family Guy, American Dad! and The Cleveland Show, for which he also voices many of the shows' various characters. source: Rocky is a boxing saga written by and starring Sylvester Stallone, who plays the character Rocky Balboa, a fictional southpaw boxer. The films series has grossed more than $1 billion worldwide. Rocky first appeared in the episode "Petergeist", which first aired on May 7, 2006.

question: Who is Donna Tubbs-Brown?

source: Donna Tubbs-Brown is Cleveland Brown's second wife, after his first wife Loretta had an affair with one of Cleveland's old friends, Glenn Quagmire, causing them to divorce. She works as the principal's assistant at Stoolbend High School. She has two children from her previous marriage to Robert Tubbs, named Roberta and Rallo. As a result of her marriage to Cleveland, she has gained a stepson Cleveland Brown, Jr.. Full name: Donna Tubbs-Brown. Voiced by: Sanaa Lathan. Occupation: Homemaker, Former school secretary. Donna Tubbs-Brown first appeared in the episode "The Splendid Source", which first aired on May 16, 2010.

question: What is The Flintstones?
reply: The Flintstones was the very first animated primetime cartoon series. William Hanna and Joseph Barbera created it, and it premiered on ABC in 1960. The show followed caveman characters like Fred, Wilma, Barney and Betty in typical sitcom situations, and it first showed up on Family Guy in "From Method to Madness" (January 24, 2002).
source: The Flintstones was the very first animated primetime cartoon series created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera. Premiering on ABC in 1960, the show featured a community of caveman characters in typical sitcom situations. The central characters are construction worker Fred Flintstone, his wife Wilma, baby Pebbles, pet dinosaur Dino, and neighbors Barney and Betty Rubble and their son Bamm-Bamm. The Flintstones first appeared in the episode "From Method to Madness", which first aired on January 24, 2002.

question: Who is Peter Griffin?

question: Who is Robert E. Lee?
reply: Robert E. Lee was a career military officer, best known for commanding the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia in the American Civil War. On Family Guy, he first appeared in "Peter, Peter, Caviar Eater," which first aired on September 23, 1999.

question: Who is Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis?
reply: Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis was First Lady of the United States from 1961 to 1963, as the wife of President John F. Kennedy. She later married Aristotle Onassis and worked as a book editor, and her first Family Guy appearance was in "Road to the Multiverse."
source: Jacqueline Lee Bouvier Kennedy Onassis (July 28, 1929 – May 19, 1994) was the wife of the 35th President of the United States, John F. Kennedy, and served as First Lady during his presidency from 1961 until his assassination in 1963. She was later married to Greek shipping magnate Aristotle Onassis from 1968 until his death in 1975. For the final two decades of her life, she had a successful career as a book editor. She is remembered for her contributions to the arts and historic preservation, her style and elegance. Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis first appeared in the episode "Road to the Multiverse", which first aired on September 27, 2009.

source: Jesus of Nazareth (c. 5 BC/BCE – c. 30 AD/CE), also known as Jesus Christ or simply Jesus, is the central figure of Christianity. Christians view him as the Messiah foretold in the Old Testament and as the Son of God, who provided salvation and reconciliation with God to humankind by dying for their sins, then raising himself from the dead. In the early episodes, adult Jesus was voiced by Seth MacFarlane. In more recent episodes, Alec Sulkin has taken over the role. Full name: Jesus Christ. Voiced by: Seth MacFarlane (early episodes), Alec Sulkin (later episodes), David Goodman (Stu & Stewie's Excellent Adventure), Seth Green as Young Jesus in "The Courtship of Stewie's Father", etc. Jesus Christ first appeared in the episode "Chitty Chitty Death Bang", which first aired on April 18, 1999.

question: What is June Is Busting Out All Over?
reply: "June Is Busting Out All Over" is a song from Rodgers and Hammerstein's 1945 musical Carousel. It shows up in the Family Guy episode "The Birthday Bootlegger", first aired November 21, 2021, where Peter Griffin, Leslie Uggams and the Griffin family sing it.
page: June Is Busting Out All Over
source: "June Is Busting Out All Over" is a song from the musical Carousel by Rodgers and Hammerstein in 1945,and was adapted as a film in 1956. "June Is Busting Out All Over" is a song from the episode "The Birthday Bootlegger". Sung by: Peter Griffin, Leslie Uggams, Griffin Family. June Is Busting Out All Over first appeared in the episode "The Birthday Bootlegger", which first aired on November 21, 2021.

question: Who is Horace?
reply: Horace was the longtime bartender at The Drunken Clam. He served Peter, Cleveland and Quagmire there for decades, and he was voiced by John G. Brennan. He first appeared in "Wasted Talent," which aired on July 25, 2000.
source: Horace was the bartender at The Drunken Clam. He had been the bartender there for decades, at least as long as Peter Griffin, Cleveland Brown, and Glenn Quagmire had been drinking there. Full name: Horace. Voiced by: John G. Brennan. Age: deceased. Occupation: Bartender. Horace first appeared in the episode "Wasted Talent", which first aired on July 25, 2000.

question: Who is Gene Shalit?
reply: Gene Shalit was a film and book critic. He held that job on NBC's Today from 1973 until 2010 and was known for his puns, his huge handlebar moustache and his colorful bowties. He first showed up on Family Guy in "Family Guy Viewer Mail No. 1."
source: Gene Shalit (March 25, 1926-June 12, 2026) was a film and book critic. He had filled these roles on NBC's Today from January 15, 1973 until November 2010. He is known for his frequent use of puns, his oversized handlebar moustache, and for wearing colorful bowties. Gene Shalit first appeared in the episode "Family Guy Viewer Mail No. 1", which first aired on February 14, 2002.

question: Who is Roberta Tubbs?
reply: Roberta Coretta Tubbs is Cleveland Brown's 15-year-old stepdaughter and the eldest daughter of Donna Tubbs-Brown. She was named after her father, Robert, and she's the older sister of Rallo and stepsister of Cleveland Brown, Jr.
source: Roberta Coretta Tubbs is the eldest daughter of Donna Tubbs-Brown and Cleveland Brown's stepdaughter. She was named after her father, Robert and has a younger brother named Rallo and is step-sister to Cleveland Brown, Jr.. Full name: Roberta Coretta Tubbs. Age: 15. Occupation: School Student. Roberta Tubbs first appeared in the episode "He's Bla-ack!", which first aired on May 11, 2014.

question: Who is William Shakespeare?
answers: greatest writer in the English language
reply: William Shakespeare (April 1564 – 23 April 1616) was an English poet, playwright and actor. He's regarded as the greatest writer in the English language. On Family Guy, he first appeared in "Road to India," which first aired on May 22, 2016.
source: William Shakespeare (April 1564 – 23 April 1616) was an English poet, playwright, and actor, regarded as the greatest writer in the English language. William Shakespeare first appeared in the episode "Road to India", which first aired on May 22, 2016.

question: Who is Esther?
answers: student at James Woods Regional High School
reply: Esther is one of Meg's friends. She hangs out with Meg alongside Ruth and Patty, wears glasses, and goes to James Woods Regional High School. Tamera Mowry voiced her at first, and Christina Milian has voiced her since "Halloween on Spooner Street."
source: Esther is one of Meg's circle of friends, along with Ruth and Patty. Like Meg and Patty, she wears glasses. Full name: Esther. Voiced by: Tamera Mowry in "Barely Legal" and "Peter's Daughter", Christina Milian in "Halloween on Spooner Street" to present. Occupation: Student at James Woods Regional High School. question: Who is Alex Borstein?
reply: Alex Borstein, born February 15, 1971, is the voice of Lois Griffin, and she voices several other characters on Family Guy too. She's also one of the show's supervising producers and used to be one of its writers.
source: Alexandrea Borstein (born February 15, 1971) performs the voice of Lois Griffin and several other characters on Family Guy, and is also one of the show's supervising producers and former writer. Alex Borstein first appeared in the episode "Creating the Chaos", which first aired on April 18, 2009.

question: What is Boston Red Sox?
reply: The Boston Red Sox are a professional baseball team from Boston, Massachusetts, and they play in Major League Baseball's American League East. They were founded in 1901 and have played at Fenway Park since 1912. They first appeared in the Family Guy episode "Mr. Griffin Goes to Washington," which aired on July 25, 2001.
source: The Boston Red Sox are a professional baseball team based in Boston, Massachusetts, and a member of the Major League Baseball’s American League Eastern Division. Founded in 1901 as one of the American League's eight charter franchises, the Red Sox's home ballpark has been Fenway Park since 1912. The "Red Sox" name was chosen by the team owner, John I. Taylor, around 1908, following previous Boston teams that had been known as the "Red Stockings". Boston Red Sox first appeared in the episode "Mr. Griffin Goes to Washington", which first aired on July 25, 2001.

question: Who is Chip?
reply: Chip is Peter's vestigial twin. Peter finds him growing out of his neck in "Vestigial Peter," which first aired on October 6, 2013.
source: Chip is the vestigial twin Peter discovers growing out of his neck in "Vestigial Peter". Chip first appeared in the episode "Vestigial Peter", which first aired on October 6, 2013.

question: Who is Joyce Kinney?
reply: Joyce Kinney is a co-anchor on Quahog 5 News. She works alongside Tom Tucker and took over from Diane Simmons after Stewie killed Diane in "And Then There Were Fewer." Her first appearance was in "Excellence in Broadcasting," and Christine Lakin voices her.
source: Joyce Kinney, born Joyce Chevapravatdumrong, is Diane Simmons's replacement on Quahog 5 News after Simmons was killed by Stewie Griffin in "And Then There Were Fewer". She first appeared in "Excellence in Broadcasting". Tom Tucker, her new co-anchor, did not let her run a story in her debut. She is also in the new Family Guy opening theme. She is also seen in a photo when Brian and Tom are walking in the studio in "Brian Writes a Bestseller". Full name: Joyce Kinney. Voiced by: Christine Lakin. Occupation: Quahog 5 News Co-Anchor with Tom Tucker from "Excellence in Broadcasting" to present. Joyce Kinney first appeared in the episode "Excellence in Broadcasting", which first aired on October 3, 2010.

question: What is Time for Timer?
reply: Time for Timer was a series of animated nutrition and fitness public service announcements that aired during ABC's Saturday morning programming from 1973 to 1998. The series was named after Timer, a tiny yellow blob who stood for the body's "biological clock," and Family Guy first referenced it in "Petarded."
source: Time for Timer was the collective title of a series of nutrition- and fitness-related public service announcements that aired on ABC's Saturday morning programming block from 1973 through 1998. These animated 30-second and one-minute shorts were named for the main character: a yellow, microscopic-sized blob who wore a bow tie and top hat with long arms and legs. He was said to represent the body's "biological clock," in charge of when it was time to do things such as eat and sleep. The shorts were produced by DePatie-Freleng Enterprises. Time for Timer first appeared in the episode "Petarded", which first aired on June 19, 2005.

question: Who is Joseph?
reply: Joseph is Saint Joseph the Carpenter: the husband of the virgin Mary and the stepfather, or foster-father, of Jesus Christ. His first appearance on Family Guy was in "The Courtship of Stewie's Father," which first aired on November 20, 2005.
source: Saint Joseph, often clarified as Saint Joseph the Carpenter is an important figure in Christian belief as the husband of the virgin Mary and the stepfather of Jesus Christ. According to Christian tradition, he was not the biological father of Jesus, but acted as his foster-father and as head of the Holy Family. Joseph first appeared in the episode "The Courtship of Stewie's Father", which first aired on November 20, 2005.

question: What is The Sopranos?
reply: The Sopranos is an American crime drama TV series about mobster Tony Soprano and his family. In Family Guy it first shows up in "Bookie of the Year," which first aired on October 2, 2016.
source: The Sopranos is an American crime drama television series revolving around the fictional character and family of mobster Tony Soprano. The Sopranos first appeared in the episode "Bookie of the Year", which first aired on October 2, 2016.

question: Who is Liam Neeson?
reply: Liam Neeson is an Irish actor known for films like Schindler's List, Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace, Taken and the Chronicles of Narnia series. His first Family Guy appearance was in "Prick Up Your Ears," which first aired on November 19, 2006.
source: Liam John Neeson, OBE (born 7 June 1952) is an Irish actor known for Schindler's List, Michael Collins, Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace, Taken and the Chronicles of Narnia film series. Liam Neeson first appeared in the episode "Prick Up Your Ears", which first aired on November 19, 2006.

question: Who is Kevin Swanson?
answers: son of Joe and Bonnie Swanson
reply: Kevin Swanson is Joe and Bonnie Swanson's son and Susie's older brother. He was a US Army soldier who went AWOL but was presumed killed in action. He first showed up in "A Hero Sits Next Door" in 1999. Seth MacFarlane voiced him at first, and Scott Grimes took over starting with "Thanksgiving."
source: Kevin Swanson is the son of Joe and Bonnie Swanson, and older brother of Susie Swanson. He was voiced by Seth MacFarlane until the 10th season when he is voiced by Scott Grimes. Full name: Kevin Swanson. Voiced by: Seth MacFarlane, Scott Grimes ("Thanksgiving"-Present). Age: 25. Occupation: Worker at Quahog Mini-Mart, as seen in "Fifteen Minutes of Shame", US Army soldier, AWOL but presumed KiA. Kevin Swanson first appeared in the episode "A Hero Sits Next Door", which first aired on May 2, 1999.

question: What is Diff'rent Strokes?
reply: Diff'rent Strokes is an American TV sitcom that ran on NBC from 1978 to 1985, then moved to ABC from 1985 to 1986. Gary Coleman played Arnold Jackson and Todd Bridges played his brother Willis, two boys from Harlem who are adopted by the rich widower Philip Drummond. Family Guy first references it in "Death Has a Shadow."
source: Diff'rent Strokes is an American television sitcom that aired on the NBC television network from November 3, 1978 to May 4, 1985, and on ABC from September 27, 1985 to March 7, 1986. This sitcom starred Gary Coleman as Arnold Jackson and Todd Bridges as his older brother, Willis. They played two African-American boys from a poor Harlem neighborhood whose deceased mother previously worked for a rich white widower, Philip Drummond (Conrad Bain), who eventually adopted them. They lived in a penthouse with Mr. Drummond, his daughter Kimberly (Dana Plato), and their maid. Diff'rent Strokes first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: Who is Mark Ruffalo?
reply: Mark Ruffalo is an American actor and producer. His films include 13 Going on 30 and Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind, and The Kids Are All Right got him an Oscar nomination. On Family Guy he first appeared in "Girl, Internetted," which aired on May 5, 2019.
source: Mark Alan Ruffalo (born November 22, 1967) is an American actor and producer, notable for his work as part of the original cast of This Is Our Youth. Following were his roles in 13 Going on 30, Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind, What Doesn't Kill You and The Kids Are All Right. For the latter, he received nominations for the SAG Award, BAFTA Award, and the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor. Mark Ruffalo first appeared in the episode "Girl, Internetted", which first aired on May 5, 2019.

question: Who is Muriel Goldman?
reply: Muriel Goldman was Mort Goldman's wife and Neil Goldman's mother. She first showed up in "The Kiss Seen Around the World," which aired on August 29, 2001, and after that she appeared with her family many times.
source: Muriel Goldman was the wife of Mort Goldman and the mother of Neil Goldman. She appeared many times during the series with her family. Muriel Goldman first appeared in the episode "The Kiss Seen Around the World", which first aired on August 29, 2001.

question: Who is Lois Griffin?
answers: mother of Meg, Chris and Stewie
reply: Lois Griffin is Peter Griffin's wife. She was born Lois Patrice Pewterschmidt, and she's the mother of Meg, Chris and Stewie. She lives at 31 Spooner Street and is voiced by Alex Borstein.
source: Lois Patrice Griffin (née Pewterschmidt) is the wife of Peter Griffin and mother of Meg, Chris and Stewie Griffin. Lois lives at 31 Spooner Street with her family and also Brian, the anthropomorphic family dog. Full name: Lois Patrice Griffin. Voiced by: Alex BorsteinTatum Hentemann as Young Lois in "Valentine's Day in Quahog". Age: 43. Lois Griffin first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: Who is Bugs Bunny?
reply: Bugs Bunny is a talking rabbit from the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies cartoons, famous for asking "What's up, Doc?" He's also the corporate mascot for Warner Brothers, and he first showed up on Family Guy in "Stewie B. Goode," which aired on May 21, 2006.
source: Bugs Bunny is an American fictional character who appears in the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies series of animated films. He is a talking rabbit. His catchphrase is "What's up, Doc?", and is typically used as a greeting to anyone he encounters. In 2002, he was named by TV Guide as the greatest cartoon character of all time. Currently, he is the corporate mascot for Warner Brothers, especially its animated productions. Bugs starred in 163 shorts in the Golden Age of American animation, and made cameos in three others along with a few appearances in non-animated films. Bugs Bunny first appeared in the episode "Stewie B. Goode", which first aired on May 21, 2006.

question: Who is Tom Tucker?
reply: Tom Tucker is the narcissistic, mustachioed anchorman for Quahog 5 News, and Seth MacFarlane voices him. He co-anchors with Diane Simmons and later Joyce Kinney, and in "Stewie B. Goode" it turns out his mustache is fake.
source: Tom Tucker is the anchorman for Quahog 5 News. He's a quite narcissistic, handsome, mustachioed man who recaps news in pleasing baritone. In the first Stewie Griffin: The Untold Story segment "Stewie B. Goode", his mustache is revealed to be fake when he was fired, ordered to return it to the studio as it is actually their property. Tom is not one to be politically correct, nor does he take into account the feelings of anyone, including co-anchors Diane Simmons and most recently, Joyce Kinney. He would often make fun of Diane. Full name: Tom Tucker. Voiced by: Seth MacFarlane. Occupation: Television news co-anchor on Quahog 5 News., Actor revealed in "And Then There Were Fewer". Tom Tucker first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: Who is Cleveland Brown?
answers: central character of The Cleveland Show
reply: Cleveland Orenthal Brown, Sr. is a supporting character on Family Guy and the lead of its spin-off, The Cleveland Show. He's voiced by Mike Henry and later Arif Zahir, and was once married to Loretta, until she had an affair with Quagmire.
source: Cleveland Orenthal Brown, Sr. is a supporting character on Family Guy, and central character in the spin-off series, The Cleveland Show, which reduced him to a guest character on Family Guy until he returned. He is the token black guy in the neighborhood and a sort of novelty in Quahog which is exemplified in his trip to Barrington Country Club in "Fore Father". Until "The Cleveland-Loretta Quagmire", he was married to his wife Loretta Brown, but they separated after Loretta had an affair with Glenn Quagmire, although they still have feelings for each other. Full name: Cleveland Orenthal Brown, Sr. Voiced by: Mike HenryArif Zahir. Age: 42. Occupation: Owner of Cleveland's Deli until the Pilot of The Cleveland Show, Therapist in "Dr. C & The Women", Postal worker from "Take a Letter", Pawtucket Brewery in "Unzipped Code". Cleveland Brown first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: Who is Gretchen Mercer?
reply: Gretchen Mercer is one of Peter's ex-girlfriends. Her first appearance was in "Take a Letter," which first aired on April 17, 2016.
source: Gretchen Mercer is a former girlfriend of Peter's. Gretchen Mercer first appeared in the episode "Take a Letter", which first aired on April 17, 2016.

question: Who is George Washington?
answers: first President of the United States
commander in chief of the Continental Army
reply: George Washington was the first President of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797, and before that he led the Continental Army to victory over Britain in the Revolutionary War. His first Family Guy appearance was in "A Picture's Worth a Thousand Bucks," which aired on April 18, 2000.
source: George Washington (February 22, 1732 – December 14, 1799) was the dominant military and political leader of the new United States of America from 1775 to 1797, leading the American victory over Britain in the American Revolutionary War as commander in chief of the Continental Army, 1775–1783, and presiding over the writing of the Constitution in 1787. As the unanimous choice to serve as the first President of the United States (1789–1797), he developed the forms and rituals of government that have been used ever since, such as using a cabinet system and delivering an inaugural address. George Washington first appeared in the episode "A Picture's Worth a Thousand Bucks", which first aired on April 18, 2000.

question: Who is Greased-up Deaf Guy?
answers: man chased in a picnic contest
reply: Greased-up Deaf Guy is the man people try to catch in a contest at the Happy-Go-Lucky Toy Factory company picnic, and it's Peter Griffin's favorite event. He first showed up in "The Thin White Line" (aired July 11, 2001), where he gets let out of a cage and runs screaming in a high voice into the forest.
source: The Greased-Up Deaf Guy first appeared during the Happy-Go-Lucky Toy Factory company picnic in "The Thin White Line". One of the contests at the picnic, which happens to be Peter Griffin's favorite, is to catch the Greased-Up Deaf Guy. He is released from a cage screaming in a high pitched voice, and ran off into the forest. Greased-up Deaf Guy first appeared in the episode "The Thin White Line", which first aired on July 11, 2001.

question: Who is Franklin Delano Roosevelt?
reply: Franklin Delano Roosevelt, or FDR, was the 32nd President of the United States. He won four terms and led the country out of the Great Depression and through World War II. On Family Guy, he first showed up in the episode "Peter's Sister," which first aired on November 15, 2015.
source: Franklin Delano Roosevelt (January 30, 1882 – April 12, 1945), commonly known by his initials FDR, was an American statesman and political leader who served as the 32nd President of the United States, notable for winning four terms to the office and leading the United States out of the Great Depression and through WWII. Franklin was diagnosed with polio in 1921 and spent much of his latter life in a wheelchair. Despite his condition being accepted and commonly known, FDR and his staff went to lengths to hide any appearance of weakness. Franklin Delano Roosevelt first appeared in the episode "Peter's Sister", which first aired on November 15, 2015.

question: Who is Dylan Flannigan?
reply: Dylan Flannigan is Brian's son with Tracy Flannigan. Brian left Tracy before Dylan was born, so Dylan grew up without his father. He first appeared in "The Former Life of Brian," which aired on April 27, 2008.
source: Dylan Flannigan is the son of Brian and Tracy Flannigan, introduced in "The Former Life of Brian". Brian left Tracy before Dylan was born, leaving him not knowing what it's like to have a father. When he visits Tracy, she had become a fat slob. Tracy told Brian and Stewie about Dylan when they went to visit her. Brian goes back to the house and tells Peter and Lois about him. Tracy soon drops Dylan off at Brian's so father and son could bond. At first, he was disrespectful towards Brian and his family. Dylan Flannigan first appeared in the episode "The Former Life of Brian", which first aired on April 27, 2008.

question: Who is Britney Spears?
reply: Britney Spears is an American recording artist and entertainer, born December 2, 1981. Family Guy has made fun of her many times, but she's reportedly a big fan of the show. Her first appearance was in "Prick Up Your Ears," which first aired on November 19, 2006.
source: Britney Jean Spears (born December 2, 1981) is an American recording artist and entertainer. Spears began performing as a child, landing acting roles in stage productions and television shows. While targeted many times on Family Guy, it is reported that she is a big fan of the show. Britney Spears first appeared in the episode "Prick Up Your Ears", which first aired on November 19, 2006.

question: Who is Mario?
reply: Mario is Nintendo's mascot. Shigeru Miyamoto created him, and he's the title character of the Mario video game franchise, with appearances in more than 200 games since Donkey Kong. On Family Guy he first showed up in "Lois Comes Out of Her Shell," which aired on November 25, 2012.
source: Mario is a fictional character in the Mario video game franchise by Nintendo, created by Japanese video game designer Shigeru Miyamoto. Serving as Nintendo's mascot and the eponymous protagonist of the series, Mario has appeared in over 200 video games since his creation. Though originally only appearing in platform games, starting with Donkey Kong, Mario appears in varied video game genres such as racing, puzzle, party, role-playing, fighting and sports. Mario first appeared in the episode "Lois Comes Out of Her Shell", which first aired on November 25, 2012.

question: Who is Bert & Sheila?
reply: Bert and Sheila are an interracial couple who took over as managers of the Pawtucket Brewery after Angela died in "Pawtucket Pete." They got the job because one of the shareholders' favorite songs was "Ebony and Ivory." Bryan Cranston voices Bert and Niecy Nash voices Sheila.
source: Bert and Sheila are an interracial couple who become new managers at the Pawtucket Brewery following the death of Angela in "Pawtucket Pete". They were hired because one of the shareholder's favorite songs was "Ebony and Ivory". They have a habit of completing sentences while alternating the words between themselves and to make things easier for the employees to remember them, they suggested that they could be referred to as 'Beila' or 'Shurt.' Voiced by: Bryan Cranston (Bert), Niecy Nash (Sheila). Occupation: Former Bosses of Pawtucket Brewery. Bert & Sheila first appeared in the episode "Pawtucket Pete", which first aired on December 9, 2018.

question: Who is Cleveland Brown, Jr.?
answers: son of Cleveland and Loretta Brown
reply: Cleveland Brown, Jr. is the son of Cleveland and Loretta Brown. He started out as a very hyperactive boy who talks fast and has a short attention span. He first showed up in "Love Thy Trophy," which aired on March 14, 2000.
source: Cleveland Orenthal Brown, Jr., commonly referred to as Cleveland, Jr., is the son of Cleveland and Loretta Brown. He was first depicted as a very hyperactive boy and speaks quickly, with a rather short attention span. Full name: Cleveland Orenthal Brown, Jr. Voiced by: Mike HenryKevin Michael Richardson. Age: 14. Occupation: School Student. Cleveland Brown, Jr. first appeared in the episode "Love Thy Trophy", which first aired on March 14, 2000.

question: What is The Sound of Music?
reply: The Sound of Music is a 1965 musical film. Robert Wise directed it, Julie Andrews and Christopher Plummer star in it, and it's based on the Rodgers and Hammerstein Broadway musical. It first showed up on Family Guy in the episode "PTV," which first aired on November 6, 2005.
source: The Sound of Music is a 1965 musical film directed by Robert Wise and starring Julie Andrews and Christopher Plummer. The film is based on the Broadway musical The Sound of Music, with songs written by Richard Rodgers and Oscar Hammerstein II, and with the musical book written by the writing team of Howard Lindsay and Russel Crouse. Ernest Lehman wrote the screenplay. The Sound of Music first appeared in the episode "PTV", which first aired on November 6, 2005.

question: Who is Harry Potter?
answers: titular boy wizard of J. K. Rowling's series
reply: Harry Potter is the title character and main hero of J. K. Rowling's Harry Potter series. He's an orphan who finds out on his eleventh birthday that he's a wizard, and he goes on to attend Hogwarts. On Family Guy he first showed up in "Peterotica," which aired on April 23, 2006.
source: Harry James Potter is the titular character and the primary protagonist of J. K. Rowling's Harry Potter series. The main story of the books covers seven years in the life of the orphan who, on his eleventh birthday, learns he is a wizard. He attends Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry to learn magic under the guidance of the kind headmaster Albus Dumbledore. Harry also discovers that he is already famous throughout the wizarding world, and that his fate is tied with that of Lord Voldemort, the universally feared Dark wizard who killed Harry's mother and father. Harry Potter first appeared in the episode "Peterotica", which first aired on April 23, 2006.

question: Who is Miles "Chatterbox" Musket?
reply: Miles "Chatterbox" Musket founded Quahog. He talked so much that his crew threw him overboard on the way to America, and a clam saved him and carried him to Rhode Island. He first appeared in "Fifteen Minutes of Shame" (April 25, 2000).
source: Miles "Chatterbox" Musket was the founder of Quahog, according to "Fifteen Minutes of Shame". Miles had the bad habit of talking nonstop. On his voyage to America, he was thrown overboard by his crew for talking about what he would do when he got to the new world. A clam saved him from drowning and brought him to Rhode Island. They became friends until he also drove the clam to irritation with his talking. The clam snapped at him asking if he ever shut up. Miles considered shooting the clam in his sleep but reconsidered, not knowing the clam saw him, and decided to leave him. Miles "Chatterbox" Musket first appeared in the episode "Fifteen Minutes of Shame", which first aired on April 25, 2000.

question: Who is Ron Jones?
reply: Ron Jones is one of Family Guy's two main composers, and Walter Murphy is the other. He was nominated for an Emmy for "This House Is Freakin' Sweet!" and again for his score for "Lois Kills Stewie." He also scored Star Trek: The Next Generation and DuckTales.
source: Ron Jones is one of the two main composers for Family Guy, the other being Walter Murphy. His other television credits include Superman, DuckTales, and Star Trek: The Next Generation, for which he paid a musical and visual homage to for the 100th episode, "Stewie Kills Lois". In 2000, he and Chris Sheridan received an Emmy Award nomination for the song "This House Is Freakin' Sweet!" from "Peter, Peter, Caviar Eater", and in 2008, he received another nomination for scoring "Lois Kills Stewie". He appears as himself in "Brian Does Hollywood" at the Woodies for Best Soundtrack. Ron Jones first appeared in the episode "Brian Does Hollywood", which first aired on July 18, 2001.

question: Who is Droopy Dog?
reply: Droopy Dog is an animated cartoon dog, supposedly a Basset Hound, with a droopy face. Tex Avery created him in 1943 for MGM's theatrical cartoon shorts. He first showed up on Family Guy in "Ocean's Three and a Half," which first aired on February 15, 2009.
source: Droopy is an animated cartoon character, an anthropomorphic dog (supposedly a Basset Hound) with a droopy face, hence the name "Droopy". He was created by Tex Avery, for theatrical cartoon shorts produced by the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer cartoon studio, in 1943. Droopy Dog first appeared in the episode "Ocean's Three and a Half", which first aired on February 15, 2009.

question: Who is Obi-Wan Kenobi?
reply: Obi-Wan Kenobi is a fictional character from Star Wars and one of the few major characters who shows up in most of the films. Alec Guinness played him in the original trilogy and Ewan McGregor in the prequels. On Family Guy, he first appeared in "The Courtship of Stewie's Father," which first aired on November 20, 2005.
source: Obi-Wan Kenobi is a fictional character in the Star Wars universe. He is one of several primary characters in the Star Wars series. Along with Anakin Skywalker/Darth Vader, R2-D2, and C-3PO, he is one of the few major characters to appear in most of the Star Wars films. He is portrayed in the original trilogy by Alec Guinness as a supporting protagonist and in the prequel trilogy by Ewan McGregor as a major character. Obi-Wan Kenobi first appeared in the episode "The Courtship of Stewie's Father", which first aired on November 20, 2005.

question: Who is Jim Kaplan?
reply: Jim Kaplan is a conman, also called "The Salesman," and you can spot him by his permanent wide, insincere smile. A lot of his cons target Peter because Peter is gullible. Danny Smith voices him, and his first appearance was in "I Am Peter, Hear Me Roar."
source: "The Salesman", AKA Jim Kaplan is a conman, characterized by his permanent wide insincere smile. He has a bank and tattoo parlor. Many of his cons are directed at Peter since he is gullible and easy to fool. Full name: "The Salesman", Jim Kaplan, Doug. Voiced by: Danny Smith. Occupation: Sports Agent, Volcano Insurance Salesman, Tattoo Artist, Banker, Car Salesman, Quahog Thrift Store clerk, Owner of Cash$cam. Jim Kaplan first appeared in the episode "I Am Peter, Hear Me Roar", which first aired on March 28, 2000.

question: Who is Bill Cosby?
reply: Bill Cosby is an American comedian, and he's also an actor, author, TV producer, musician and activist. He first showed up on Family Guy in "Peter, Peter, Caviar Eater," which first aired on September 23, 1999.

question: Who is John Madden?

question: Who is Ernie the Giant Chicken?
reply: Ernie is a giant chicken and Peter Griffin's longtime enemy. He tends to show up in the middle of a scene and start a long, destructive fight with Peter. Peter always wins, but Ernie gets back up after looking dead, which sets up the next fight. Danny Smith voices him, and he first appeared in "Da Boom," which aired on December 26, 1999.
source: Ernie was a giant chicken with whom Peter Griffin has had a long history of violence. He often shows up in the middle of a scene and interrupts Peter and the two engage in a long, drawn out fight won always by Peter, who then returns to the scene battered and bruised and picks up where he left off, not knowing that Ernie, seemingly dead, awakens and gets up after Peter leaves, foreshadowing another future fight. Each fight also leads to serious destruction of the environment around them and heavy casualties to bystanders. Full name: Ernie the Giant Chicken. Voiced by: Danny Smith. Age: Unknown (Deceased). Ernie the Giant Chicken first appeared in the episode "Da Boom", which first aired on December 26, 1999.

question: What is Raiders of the Lost Ark?
reply: It's a 1981 American action-adventure film. Steven Spielberg directed it, George Lucas produced it, and Harrison Ford stars as Indiana Jones, who goes up against the Nazis as they hunt for the Ark of the Covenant. It's the first film in the Indiana Jones franchise, and Family Guy first referenced it in "12 and a Half Angry Men," which aired on March 24, 2013.
source: Raiders of the Lost Ark (also known as Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark) is a 1981 American action-adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg, produced by George Lucas, and starring Harrison Ford. It is the first film in the Indiana Jones franchise; and it pits Indiana Jones (Ford) against the Nazis, who search for the Ark of the Covenant, because Adolf Hitler believes it will make their army invincible. question: Who is Rallo Tubbs?

source: Montclair "Rallo" Tubbs is a main character on the animated sitcom The Cleveland Show, the spin-off of Family Guy. question: Who is Death?
reply: Death is the Grim Reaper, a recurring Family Guy character who comes to collect people when they die. He's a mama's boy who still lives with his mother. Adam Carolla voices him, but Norm MacDonald voiced him in his first appearance, "Death Is a Bitch," which first aired on March 21, 2000.
source: Death, also known as the Grim Reaper, is a recurring character on Family Guy. When people die, he comes to collect them. He has also stated that he has lost his gag reflex due to taking part in films he is not proud of, as is evident when he eats a turkey leg off the bone in less than 3 seconds. question: What is Rupert?

source: Jerry "Rupert" Suarez is Stewie Griffin's teddy bear. Though inanimate, Rupert has become his personal confidant and best friend. He varies from Stewie's boyfriend to husband on occasion. question: Who is Walt Disney?

question: What is Griffin Family?
reply: The Griffin Family is Peter Griffin's family. Peter is an obese blue-collar worker and an over-the-top caricature of middle America. The Griffin Family first appeared in "Disney's The Reboot," which originally aired on October 20, 2019.
source: Peter Griffin Peter is a stereotypical obese, blue collar worker. He is mentally disabled and usually says whatever is on his mind, often in the wrong place, and at the wrong time. Peter Griffin is a larger than life caricature of middle America. He is epitomized by complete social ineptitude and an exceptionally low I.Q.. He has no personal identity of his own and is swept away by the whims of whatever comes to mind, be it patriotism, racism, anti-racism, homosexuality, family values, etc. His character is a dig at how debased American society has become. Griffin Family first appeared in the episode "Disney's The Reboot", which first aired on October 20, 2019.

question: Who is Brian Griffin?

source: Brian Edward Griffin is a 10-year old talking white Labrador who has lived with the Griffin family since Peter picked him up as a stray as shown in "Brian: Portrait of a Dog". In "I Never Met the Dead Man", "Jerome Is the New Black", and in the afterparty of Stewie Griffin: The Untold Story, he used the phrase "Whose leg do you have to hump to get a dry martini around here?", which has become a recurring mantra for him, despite only using it three times. Full name: Brian Edward Griffin (Last name extended as a courtesy). Voiced by: Seth MacFarlane, Kotaro Watanabe (in the Japanese universe of "Road to the Multiverse"). Age: 10 (64 in dog years). Brian Griffin first appeared in the episode "Death Has a Shadow", which first aired on January 31, 1999.

question: Which U.S. state borders North Dakota to the west?

source: It is located in the Upper Midwestern region of the United States, bordered by the Canadian provinces of Saskatchewan and Manitoba to the north, the states of Minnesota to the east, South Dakota to the south, and Montana to the west.

question: Under United States copyright law, who is the initial copyright owner of a "work for hire" made by an employee within the scope of their employment?
reply: The employer owns the copyright first. The employee who actually came up with the work and fixed it in form does not, as long as they made it within the scope of their job.
source: If the person doing the work is an "employee" within the meaning of the common law, and the work was done within the scope of his employment (whether the work is the kind he was employed prepare; whether the preparation takes place primarily within the employer's time and place specifications; and whether the work was activated, at least in part, by a purpose to serve the employer), then the work is a work for hire and the employer is the initial owner of the copyright, rather than the employee who actually conceived and fixed the expression.
